name: list_projects
description: List the task projects in this workspace.

name: get_agent_stats
description: Agent work statistics grouped by model: current and blocked counts, closes in 7 days and the 7 before, eight weeks of velocity, ranking and leaders. Unknown models share Other. Returns aggregates without task details. Omit project for the whole workspace; failed projects are named in broken.

project.description: The projectId from list_projects; omit for workspace totals.

name: list_tasks
description: List tasks, most urgent first: every open one and those closed in the last 7 days, in one project or, with no project, in every project of the workspace, each then naming its project. Each is a summary, leaving out fields with no value; get_task reads one in full. Filters narrow it live, so search here rather than keeping a copy. Answers a page at a time: pass nextOffset as offset for the next.

project.description: The projectId from list_projects; leave it out to list every project.

query.description: Only tasks whose id, title, description, acceptance or labels hold every word of this, ignoring case.

ready.description: Only tasks with nothing blocking them.

assignee.description: Only tasks assigned to this name; "me" for the tasks you hold.

parent.description: Only the direct children of this task.

labels.description: Only tasks carrying every one of these labels.

type.description: Only these types, such as decision or gate.

created_after.description: Only tasks created at or after this: YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO time.

updated_after.description: Only tasks changed at or after this.

updated_before.description: Only tasks last changed before this.

closed_days.description: Read closed tasks from this many days (default 7, at most 56), for historical gate audits.

offset.description: Skip this many, from the previous answer's nextOffset.

name: get_task
description: Read one task with its comments.

task.description: The task id, such as abc-1x2.

name: get_task_history
description: Read changed fields, old/new values, recorded actors and actions, newest first. Unmatched audit events have no revision; unknown models remain null. Set snapshots for full task versions.

task.description: The task id, such as abc-1x2.

snapshots.description: Include full task snapshots instead of compact field changes (default false).

name: create_task
description: Create a task in a project, with its links, naming your model. The result's lint names sections it still lacks; add them with update_task. create_tasks files many in one call.

type.description: decision records a choice; label it human when a person must make it.

depends_on.description: Tasks this one waits on: it is not ready until they close.

blocks.description: Tasks that wait on this one.

related.description: Tasks it relates to, without waiting on them; may name another project in this workspace.

discovered_from.description: Tasks whose work turned this one up.

approval.description: What a person must approve before it proceeds. Opens a gate that holds it out of ready work, as request_human_approval does.

choices.description: When the task needs a person to pick one option. The Tower shows one button per option; the pick comes back on the task as choice.

question.description: What the person decides, asked as a question.

key.description: a for the first option, b for the second, and so on in order.

label.description: One line: the words on the option's button.

detail.description: What choosing it means, when the label leaves it out.

recommended.description: true on exactly one option: the one you recommend.

card.description: What the work is worth, for work meant to change money. The Tower ranks tasks by it; a task without one is listed, not ranked. The server records who wrote it and when.

valuePerMonth.description: The change in ledger value it predicts, USD a month, -1000000 to 1000000; a loss it avoids counts as positive.

likelihood.description: How likely it pays off, 0.01 to 0.99.

reviewMinutes.description: The operator's minutes to review and decide it, 0 to 100000; the ranking prices them.

buildMinutes.description: Your minutes to build it, 0 to 1000000; shown beside the ranking, not priced.

daysToSignal.description: Whole days until the ledger shows whether it worked, 1 to 730.

measurability.description: How the change is measured: cohort, holdout, or unmeasured when neither applies.

durability.description: How durable and diversified the gain is, a multiplier from 0.5 to 1.2; 1 when left out.

state.description: One line: the state that, still true on date, gives the task up.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. It is also the task's due date.

kill.description: When to give up on it.

note.description: One line: why the money moves.

change_class.description: The kind of change the task makes. The autonomy ladder and the likelihood priors are kept by it.

metadata.description: The complete source identity from a copied NoticeOS handoff. Only these five fields are accepted; they grant no authority.

model.description: The name of the model you run as, as you would say it. Pass it on every new task, claim and close: the Tower shows it beside your name, and the Agents page ranks your work by it.

idempotency_key.description: A key you choose for this call. Retrying with the same key and arguments never repeats the change.

name: create_tasks
description: Create up to 25 tasks in one call, in order, naming your model. A parent or link may name an earlier task of the same call as #0 for the first, #1 for the second. Stops at the first task refused and says which; retrying with the same idempotency_key and tasks never files one twice.

description: Assign an open task to yourself and start it, naming your model. Fails if someone else holds it.

task.description: The task id, such as abc-1x2.

description: Change a task's fields. Use close_task to close one and claim_task to take one. The result's lint names sections it still lacks.

task.description: The task id, such as abc-1x2.

parent.description: A parent task id, or "" for none.

defer.description: YYYY-MM-DD to hide it until then, or "" to clear.

related.description: Add nonblocking related tasks in this workspace, including other projects.

choices.description: A whole new set of choices, or null to take them off. Refused once a person has chosen.

question.description: What the person decides, asked as a question.

name: comment_on_task
description: Add a comment to a task.

task.description: The task id, such as abc-1x2.

idempotency_key.description: A key you choose for this call. Retrying with the same key and arguments never repeats the change.

name: request_human_approval
description: Ask a person to approve before a task proceeds. This opens a gate, a separate item that holds the task out of ready work until the owner approves its scope. Record an existing answer with reconcile_task. To ask without holding the task, comment on it instead. Asking again with the same reason returns the open request.

task.description: The task id, such as abc-1x2.

reason.description: What the person is asked to approve.

name: close_task
description: Close a task with the reason it is done, citing evidence such as a commit or URL, and naming your model. When nothing shipped, pass the resolution that says why; the reason still cites the evidence. A task it depends on may still be open; an approval it waits on must first be answered or retired. A declined action must not happen.

task.description: The task id, such as abc-1x2.

resolution.description: How it ended: done (the default) when the work shipped; wont-do, duplicate, cant-reproduce or already-handled when nothing did.

duplicate_of.description: With resolution duplicate: the id of the task in this project it duplicates. The two are linked as related.

model.description: The name of the model you run as, as you would say it. Pass it on every new task, claim and close: the Tower shows it beside your name, and the Agents page ranks your work by it.

idempotency_key.description: A key you choose for this call. Retrying with the same key and arguments never repeats the change.
